# scale-forecasting

> Declarative, multi-runtime enterprise time-series forecasting platform for Google Cloud. One frozen Pydantic `RunConfig` orchestrates 37 models across 5 families (`statistical`, `ml`, `deep_learning`, `automl`, `native`), 21 evaluation metrics, 7 compute runtimes (`spark`, `ray`, `vertex`, `gce`, `gke`, `vertex_automl`, `bigquery`), rolling-origin backtesting, Optuna HPO, conformal/quantile calibration (`conformal`, `aci`, `aci_normalized`), FPP3 spatial/temporal/cross-temporal hierarchical reconciliation, and stacked ensembling into a self-documenting 5-table, 11-view BigQuery registry with Knowledge Catalog and a stateful BigQuery Conversational Analytics `DataAgent`.

## Agent-First Surfaces (MCP, Skills & Schemas)

- [AI Agents, Skills & MCP Guide](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/agent_and_mcp_guide/): How to connect Google Antigravity (`agy` CLI & IDE), Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, and Windsurf via the built-in MCP server (`python -m scale_forecasting.mcp`), `SKILL.md`, and JSON Schema.
- [RunConfig JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/schemas/run_config.schema.json): Machine-readable schema for `RunConfig` with editor autocomplete (`"$schema": "https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/schemas/run_config.schema.json"`).
- [Comprehensive LLM Context Bundle (`llms-full.txt`)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/llms-full.txt): Single-file reference containing all `RunConfig` fields, all 37 models, 21 metrics, 7 runtimes, 13 extras, and 5 execution paths.
- [Repository Portable Skill (`skills/scale-forecasting/SKILL.md`)](https://github.com/statmike/scale-forecasting/blob/main/skills/scale-forecasting/SKILL.md): Portable Agent Skill with Progressive Disclosure reference tables.

## Reference & Operations

- [Configuration Reference (`RunConfig`)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/configuration_reference/): Complete JSON configuration guide.
- [Forecaster's Workbench](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/forecaster_workbench/): Physical bounds, monotone quantiles, Newsvendor targets, SBC demand regimes, fold-safe hygiene, FVA, horizon decay, Trigg bias, AR(1) time rollup, THieF temporal & cross-temporal reconciliation, top-down Goal-Seek QP (`allocate_target`), compositional simplex (`clr`/`ilr`), Double-ML promo elasticity (`promo_elasticity_df`), cold-start NPI donor transfer (`cold_start_transfer_df`), online ACI conformal calibration (`aci_df`), joint copula trajectories & tail risk (`sample_trajectories`, `tail_risk_df`), multi-modal time-series similarity, donor matching, SKU substitutes & emerging trends (`similarity_df`, `find_similar_series_df`, `cluster_by_similarity_df`, `recommend_substitutes_df`, `detect_emerging_trends_df`, `compute_time_series_similarity`), portfolio inventory optimization (`optimize_inventory_df`), lifecycle markdown, space reclamation & vendor contract volume MILP (`optimize_clearance_df`, `optimize_contract_volume_df`), assortment delisting transference (`optimize_assortment_df`), simplex size-curve & integer pre-pack allocation (`optimize_prepacks_df`), lateral store-to-store rebalancing (`optimize_rebalancing_df`), prescriptive price & promo optimization (`optimize_scenario`), scenarios, and executive HTML/JSON reports.
- [Time-Series Similarity & Merchandising](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/time_series_similarity/): 7-lens mathematical similarity (`hybrid`, `physics_attractor`, `spectral_phase`, `elastic_dtw`, `minirocket`, `structural_signature`, `foundation_latent`), multi-modal text/attribute/hierarchy fusion, Day-0 to Day-14 cold-start donor transfer, inventory-aware SKU substitutes (`recommend_substitutes_df`), and emerging trend breakouts (`detect_emerging_trends_df`).
- [Temporal & Cross-Temporal Reconciliation](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/temporal_reconciliation_reference/): Mode 1 spatial (`BottomUp`, `WLS-Struct`, `MinT-Shrink`, `MinT-NonNeg`), Mode 2 temporal (`THieF`), and Mode 3 cross-temporal (`cross_temporal_mint`) coherence plus compositional simplex (`@transform_clr`, `@transform_ilr`).
- [Auto-Forecaster & Bounded `autofocus`](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/auto_forecaster/): Step 0 data profiling (`Forecaster.profile_data`), observational exposure tiers (`first_light`, `wide_field`, `deep_sky`, `deep_field`), multi-branch `autofocus` refinement with cell borrowing, 7-Question Practitioner Assessment (`f.practitioner_assessment_df()`, `f.compare_models()`), 7-runtime parametric wall-clock predictor, 20 synthetic DGP benchmarks, and AlphaEvolve calibration.
- [Auto-Forecaster Benchmarks (29 Datasets & AlphaEvolve)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/auto_forecaster_benchmarks/): Full 4-tier × `autofocus` progression across 20 synthetic DGP recipes, 8 AlphaEvolve evolution stages, and 9 public open-data benchmarks (`M5`, `Favorita`, `M4`, `Monash`, `ETT`).
- [Auto-Forecaster Cloud Scale (7 Runtimes & AutoML)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/auto_forecaster_cloud_scale/): 70+ live Google Cloud runs (`10` -> `100,000` series) across `bigquery`, `spark`, `vertex` (`L4` GPU & CPU), `gce`, `gke`, `ray`, and `vertex_automl` (`vertex_tide`, `vertex_l2l`), plus cross-run cell borrowing.
- [AlphaEvolve Runtime Harness (Opt-In)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/alphaevolve_runner/): Opt-in evolutionary code discovery (`Forecaster.evolve`, `python -m scale_forecasting.evolve`) across `# EVOLVE-BLOCK` targets (`features`, `ensemble`, `model`, `policy`, `similarity_kernel`) with AST security sandbox, temporal lookahead probe, and 3-Gate Anti-Overfitting Ratchet (default `backend='alphaevolve'` on Gemini Enterprise Discovery Engine + `backend='vertex_gemini'` backup on Vertex AI Gemini).
- [Models Reference (37 Models)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/models_reference/): All 37 models, covariate support, explainability, and granular extras.
- [Metrics Reference (21 Metrics)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/metrics_reference/): All 16 point and 5 interval metrics.
- [Runtimes Reference (7 Runtimes)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/runtimes_reference/): Dataproc, Ray, Vertex CustomJob, GCE, GKE, Vertex AutoML, and BigQuery ML.
- [Using the Python SDK (`Forecaster`)](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/using_the_sdk/): Programmatic execution, monitoring, review, and plotting.
- [Output Schemas & Views](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/output_schemas/): DDL and query recipes for the 5 registry tables, 11 self-documenting analytical views, and Knowledge Catalog / BigQuery DataAgent.
- [Operations & Surgical Repair](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/operations/): Probing, settling, canceling, and repairing runs (`retry_run`, `registry.ops`).
- [Live Validation Ledger](https://statmike.github.io/scale-forecasting/validation/): Proven `run_id` records across 42 smokes, 20 demo configs, and 13 notebooks.
